Open Claude Code, paste the repo URL and say 'help me set this up'
Answer Claude's setup questions; it explains how to obtain a Meta API key / access token so it can control the ad account
Give Claude your existing organic videos; it generates ad creatives and ad copy and launches campaigns

Example prompt (creator's, on screen): go through the Meta library of high-performing organic content, tell me what you need to get ads running, ask for COGS context, then propose a plan to sell through remaining inventory

relevance.why: Paid acquisition is the step most solo founders avoid; an agent that turns existing video into Meta ads and manages spend via the Marketing API maps directly onto launching our own apps. Numbers are specific and the pattern (skills repo + Marketing API token + budget cap) is implementable in Claude Code.

implement_score.why: Worth a pilot once we have a product to sell: clone the repo, create a Meta system-user token with ads_management scope, set a hard daily budget cap, and let Claude propose campaigns with human approval before publish. Do NOT hand it a card with no cap. One or two days to wire up; the risk is burning spend on untested creative.
